name: VitaminP
description: Accurate whole-cell and nuclear segmentation is essential for precision pathology and spatial omics, yet routine hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining provides limited cytoplasmic contrast, restricting analyses to nuclei. Multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) facilitates precise whole-cell delineation but remains constrained by cost and accessibility. We introduce VitaminP, a cross-modal learning framework enabling whole cell segmentation from H&E images.
